### Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template — `DATA_ROOT` via `--data-root`, the rest via `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | nf-core/cellpainting output directory (cytotable/, cellprofiler/, pipeline_info/). |
| `METADATA_FILE` | — | The screen's plate map, CSV or TSV, one row per well with a plate and a well column (plate/well or Metadata_Plate/Metadata_Well) and any design columns. Defaults to input/platemap.csv under DATA_ROOT. |
| `METADATA_ID_COL` | — | Plate-map key. The hub joins on well_id, built from the plate and well columns, so this only records it. |
| `GROUP_COL` | — | Plate-map column the dashboard groups and filters wells by (perturbation type, compound, gene, dose). Defaults to pert_type, the JUMP Cell Painting convention (trt, negcon, poscon). |
| `GROUP_COL_DISPLAY` | — | Reader-facing label of GROUP_COL, used in filter and chart titles. |
| `IMAGES_S3_BASE` | — | S3 prefix the segmentation PNGs were pushed to (depictio images push DATA_ROOT IMAGES_S3_BASE --extensions .png); must be in the bucket the server serves images from. |

### Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `EXPECTED_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`cellprofiler/illumination_profile.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cellprofiler/illumination_profile.py) | How uneven the illumination was, per plate and channel. | `series`, `plate`, `channel`, `distance`, `correction`, `correction_range` |
| [`cellprofiler/image_quality.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cellprofiler/image_quality.py) | Image quality of every analysed site, one row per site and channel. | `site_id`, `well_id`, `plate`, `well`, `site`, `channel`, `focus_score`, `power_log_log_slope`, `percent_saturated`, `mean_intensity`, `cells_on_site` |
| [`cellprofiler/object_overlays.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cellprofiler/object_overlays.py) | The segmentation images of a run, as an image-gallery table. | `image_id`, `image_path`, `image_kind`, `well_id`, `plate`, `well`, `site`, `site_id` |
| [`cytotable/cell_embedding.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cytotable/cell_embedding.py) | A PCA of the single-cell profiles: where each cell sits in feature space. | `cell_id`, `well_id`, `well`, `group`, `pc_1`, `pc_2`, `pc_3`, `pc_1_variance`, `pc_2_variance`, `pc_3_variance`, `cell_area`, `nucleus_area`, `nucleus_dna_integrated`, `cell_mito_mean` |
| [`cytotable/cell_profiles.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cytotable/cell_profiles.py) | The single-cell feature matrix, labelled with the well's perturbation group. | `cell_id`, `well_id`, `site_id`, `well`, `group`, `cell_area`, `cell_eccentricity`, `cell_form_factor`, `cell_solidity`, `nucleus_area`, `nucleus_eccentricity`, `nucleus_form_factor`, `cytoplasm_area`, `nucleus_dna_integrated`, `nucleus_dna_mean`, `cell_rna_mean`, `cell_er_mean`, `cell_agp_mean`, `cell_mito_mean`, `cytoplasm_rna_mean`, `cytoplasm_mito_mean`, `nucleus_dna_texture_contrast`, `cell_mito_texture_entropy`, `cell_mito_granularity`, `cell_er_granularity`, `cell_er_mito_correlation`, `cell_dna_rna_correlation`, `cell_mito_inner_ring_frac`, `cell_neighbors` |
